title: What Geothermal Planet-Scale Is
definition: Geothermal Planet-Scale: tapping Earth's heat at continental scale.
description:
Geothermal Planet-Scale: tapping Earth's heat at continental scale. This is Future Energy Systems at its most ambitious — deep wells research, geo logistics engineering and drilling tech operations converging on a single goal: making geo hulls real.

Why it matters: Future Energy Systems will decide reservoir engineering outcomes this century. Geothermal Planet-Scale is one of the load-bearing ideas: without working geo hulls, the larger deep wells vision stalls, and with it, the geo logistics systems that depend on it.

This database documents Geothermal Planet-Scale in full: what it is, the real research behind it today, the pieces it is built from, dated forecasts, runnable demo programs, and a teaching ladder from foundations to mastery. Every record carries a working program you can run.

title: Real Research Today: Geothermal Planet-Scale
definition: Today's documented research behind Geothermal Planet-Scale.
description:
The road to Geothermal Planet-Scale is already being paved. ITER in France is the world's largest fusion experiment, targeting first plasma and Q>10 operation. Commonwealth Fusion Systems is building SPARC, a compact high-field tokamak aiming for net energy.

Enhanced geothermal (Fervo Energy, Eavor) drills deep closed-loop wells for baseload clean power. Together these programs form the deep wells foundation that Geothermal Planet-Scale will build on — the geo logistics results, the drilling tech methods, and the institutional memory.

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as geo logistics research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

title: Readiness Estimator: Geothermal Planet-Scale
definition: Estimates Geothermal Planet-Scale readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Geothermal Planet-Scale components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a geo hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Geothermal Planet-Scale Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Geothermal Planet-Scale operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Geothermal Planet-Scale installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 24469 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where deep wells monitoring, geo logistics redundancy, or drilling tech maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Geothermal Planet-Scale Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Geothermal Planet-Scale: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Geothermal Planet-Scale — tapping Earth's heat at continental scale.

Phase 1 — Prove (deep wells): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (geo logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (drilling tech): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (reservoir engineering): geo hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and continents-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
